IDQ20835
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Final Flood Warning for the Macintyre Brook

Issued at 7:37 am AEST on Wednesday 4 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 2


FLOODING NO LONGER EXPECTED AT INGLEWOOD BRIDGE

Flooding is no longer expected along Macintyre Brook at Inglewood Bridge after peaking
well below the minor flood level early Wednesday morning. As these flows travel
downstream, small river level rises are expected along the Macintyre River at Boggabilla
and Goondiwindi late this week but are expected to remain well below minor flood levels.

Macintyre Brook:
Flooding is no longer expected along Macintyre Brook.

The Macintyre Brook at Inglewood Bridge is currently at 3.40 m and falling, below the
minor flood level. The Macintyre Brook at Inglewood Bridge is expected to remain below the
minor flood level (5.00 m).

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
This is a final warning. No further warnings will be issued for this event.
